scope: Editorial simulation of a fictional staff reporting service. State, observations, action costs and scoring are invented. This is not an Army equipment emulator, a prescribed exercise standard or readiness certification. No operational inputs or external AI connection.

modes.title: COMMEX
modes.task: Establish a fictional digital reporting exchange and prove sender, recipient and current information work together.

modes.title: STAFFEX
modes.task: Restore the fictional staff's ability to deliver a dummy report to the intended recipient and use a current update.

modes.title: WFX
modes.task: During an invented disruption, brief the staff's reporting impact, restore the exchange and verify information freshness before declaring recovery.

lanes.title: Lane 01
lanes.instructor_fault: The modeled network handoff is unavailable. The application synchronization configuration is healthy. A link indication alone does not establish the remote path.

lanes.title: Lane 02
lanes.instructor_fault: The modeled network path works, but application synchronization is unavailable. Repairing an already healthy handoff does not restore this dependency.

lanes.title: Lane 03
lanes.instructor_fault: Two independent modeled faults: the handoff and application synchronization. Restoring the path exposes the remaining application fault. Both must be resolved and the user exchange retested.
